description: Source code implementing a thread-safe queue for Samsung's OMX (OpenMAX) multimedia framework, including creation, termination, enqueue, dequeue, and element count functions.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_QueueCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a queue with a fixed number of elements, setting up mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_QueueTerminate
methods.description: Frees all allocated queue elements and terminates the mutex.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_Queue
methods.description: Enqueues data into the queue if space is available.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element from the queue.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_GetElemNum
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SetElemNum
methods.description: Sets the number of elements in the queue (used for internal management).
